selection: Adaptive follow-on after original three admitted solves; not held-out discovery.

question: What confinement multiplier can the existing full optimizer reach when directly minimizing that multiplier from the feasible H1.1 point, with every engineering constraint and original bound retained?
prior_art: Constrained scalar-objective optimization is established PROCESS functionality; pinned objectives.py and caller.py inspected directly. This is not new optimization or transport theory.

output_caution: Native banner may still label slot1 as major radius. Frozen manifest and result identify custom_min_hfact; verify output metric equals returned hfact. Do not misreport native labels.

finite_rule: One600second optimization. At most one exact physical-point validation run from its output using native radius objective and a cap just above its returned hfact, if successful. No unconstrained extra sweep.
success: A local feasible requirement candidate, not a certified global minimum or proof that all H1.0 physical designs fail.
prohibited_inference: No reactor novelty, experimental H98 guarantee, source-matched TBR, actual lifetime or net generation claim follows. No later cooling/equipment proposals are imported.
